why: A ruin on a cliff (2026-10-14): in Berry Isles the gatehouse crowns the west island's hill, a cliff 3 m above the beach the composer's bridge lands on (a jump climbs 1.1 m). With the world's connectors off (config/world.json reach.connect false), as the composed levels were made, nothing climbs it: the hill and the gatehouse on it are seen from the bridge and cannot be got to. Gate D must fail it on measure 6, naming the cliff.
